sloka: उत्पत्य चैनं मुदितो रावणः परिषस्वजे ।स भ्रात्रा सम्परिष्वक्तो यथावच्छाभिनन्दितः ।। ६.६२.९ ।।
transliteration: utpatya cainaṁ mudito rāvaṇaḥ pariṣasvaje ।sa bhrātrā sampariṣvakto yathāvacchābhinanditaḥ ।। 6.62.9 ।।

translations.english: Getting up from his seat Ravana embraced and greeted Kumbhakarna. So also, he duly rejoiced and occupied the seat.
